svg.title: OpenFilm release readiness evidence snapshot
svg.desc: On main at a0f1a4d, Verify, Render QA, Windows recovery and website deployment passed after PRs 132 through 136 merged. The latest public version is 0.4.0 while package metadata says 1.0.0. Draft PR 129 candidate 04035f3 passed exact-head Verify, security, Windows recovery, DCO and three-platform Render QA. Independent GLib review, installer and workstation gates remain open.
